name: engram-compaction
description: Agent-decided compaction at the nap boundary (part of #3640). The nap leaves a request under $ENGRAM_HOME/compact/; at the end of the next answered turn this mod consumes it once and compacts, carrying the context the nap assembled. Default on (Lei, 2026-10-18); set enabled to false to turn it off.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch, default true. false registers nothing: no request is consumed and no compaction is started or answered.
